title: 34. Create accounts with stable conflict rules

examples.explanation: Create, then the same request again: 200 with the stored record.
The name exists with quota 10, and the request asks for 20: 409, and nothing changes.
A name with a quote is stored safely.

hints: ON CONFLICT(username) DO NOTHING preserves an existing row.
Read the stored row after the insert attempt, then compare its quota with the requested quota.
